marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Chun Jung Myung stars as Kim Min Ho, a gregarious young man born into a life of privilege. Although the son of a prominent businessman, he decides to make it on his own as a waiter at a cafe. Jong Soo Hee falls in love with Min Ho ; one problem though - he's both a pal and a roommate of her boyfriend, Ryu Ji Ahn, a man who's one wish in life is to relieve the financial burden plaguing his disabled parents and younger brother. As if that weren't complicated enough, there's the outgoing, yet self-doubting Choi Mi Ri who is actually Min Ho's first love. Even so, she now finds herself in love withwith a penitent gangster named Kang Ho Chil. Joining this ragtag group of characters is Oh Young Sook, a woman who disguises herseld behind a lie. Connecting all these disparate strands is the mute owner of a local eating establishment, an old woman named Mi Young. When takes as a whole, the separate plots of Goodbye Solo begin to reveal a common theme - the idea that everyone is beautiful? Just the way they are!
